lines.text: Plan failed. Back to square one.

data.define: Used when your progress is lost and you must restart.

example.text: Plan failed. Back to square one.

misuse.text: Don't say 'back to square one' after small progress.
misuse.why: It means you lost all progress.

data.l1: kembali ke titik awal; mulai lagi dari nol; kembali ke awal
data.l1_hook: Rencana gagal. Sekarang bagaimana? "back to square one".

native.tip: “back to square one” = kembali ke titik awal; mulai lagi dari nol; kembali ke awal. Contoh: “Plan failed. Back to square one.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “back to square one”?
“back to square one” = kembali ke titik awal; mulai lagi dari nol; kembali ke awal.
Contoh: “Plan failed. Back to square one.” (Rencana gagal. "back to square one".)
